privacy.metaDescription: How Wengz collects, uses, and protects your personal information.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Wengz (“we”, “us”) handles information when you use wengz.tech and related services.

who.title: Who we are
who.body: Wengz is a digital services marketplace operated at https://wengz.tech. For privacy questions, contact info@wengz.tech.

data.title: Information we collect
data.body: We may collect account details (name, email, phone), project and form submissions, payment-related records needed to process subscriptions, usage and device data (such as browser type and pages visited), and communications you send us.

use.title: How we use information
use.body: We use information to provide and improve the platform, match clients with creators, process payments and subscriptions, send transactional notifications, respond to inquiries, and keep the service secure.

share.title: Sharing
share.body: We share data with service providers who help us operate (hosting, payments, messaging) under appropriate safeguards. We may disclose information when required by law or to protect rights and safety. We do not sell your personal information.

rights.title: Your choices
rights.body: You may request access, correction, or deletion of personal data we hold about you, subject to legal and operational limits. Contact info@wengz.tech to make a request.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Email info@wengz.tech for privacy-related requests. We may update this policy from time to time; the “Last updated” date above will change when we do.

terms.metaDescription: Terms that govern use of the Wengz digital services marketplace.
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By accessing or using Wengz, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use the platform.

acceptance.title: Agreement
acceptance.body: These Terms form a binding agreement between you and Wengz regarding use of wengz.tech, accounts, subscriptions, and related services.

services.title: The service
services.body: Wengz connects clients and creators through credit-based subscriptions and project workflows. Features may change as we improve the product. The platform is currently offered in beta and may change frequently.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.body: You are responsible for accurate registration details and for keeping your credentials secure. You must be able to enter into a binding agreement under applicable law to use paid features.

credits.title: Credits, packages, and payments
credits.body: Credits and packages are subject to the plan terms shown at purchase. Fees are generally non-refundable except where required by law or expressly stated by Wengz. Misuse of credits or payment fraud may result in suspension.

conduct.title: Acceptable use
conduct.body: You may not abuse the platform, infringe others’ rights, upload unlawful content, attempt unauthorized access, or interfere with other users. We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms.

liability.title: Disclaimers and liability
liability.body: The service is provided “as is” to the fullest extent permitted by law. Wengz is not liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from use of the platform. Nothing in these Terms limits rights that cannot be waived under applicable law.

forms.body: Create a client account to start requests, or use the creator form to apply to the network.
